allowed: fit the four final method arms and source localization head
freeze route thresholds and noise floors
select margins loss weights masks queries architecture and checkpoint rules
fit unified compatibility and response probes on frozen representations
select the probe family regularization and checkpoint
forbidden: update the encoder or probe on this data

select only preregistered calibration regularization and family choices
forbidden: refit the chosen calibrator on this data

allowed: one-time source-city audit and final statistical test
forbidden: threshold calibration architecture or checkpoint selection

support_pool.allowed: headline adaptation support only; one preregistered correct or natural observation per unique receiver position

query.forbidden: gradient updates early stopping normalization threshold selection hyperparameter selection and checkpoint selection

target.support_sibling_rule: all sibling worlds edges masks and queries of a selected support position are excluded from final target statistics
target.query_freeze_rule: query positions and their sibling data never enter fitting or model selection

external_validation.allowed: preregistered external-city or stress evaluation after all source decisions are frozen
external_validation.forbidden: training normalization calibration threshold architecture or checkpoint selection

global_no_leakage_rules: Never randomly split receiver rows across permissions.
All four sibling worlds all edges all repeats all masks and all queries follow their highest-level bank or position unit.
A base-map cluster may not cross a role or city.
Observation repeats estimate variability and never count as independent scenes.
External public datasets follow docs/SPLIT_POLICY.json and never silently enter the formal main dataset.
